name: falcon-gov-mcp
description: CrowdStrike Falcon MCP server for the GovCloud CID. Full write access to IOCs, IOAs, and policies; RTR is read-only and there is no host containment tool.

falcon_gov_client_id.title: Falcon GovCloud API Client ID
falcon_gov_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID for your Falcon API client on the GovCloud CID. The scopes on this client are what govern your access; the plugin does not filter tools.

falcon_gov_client_secret.title: Falcon GovCloud API Client Secret
falcon_gov_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret paired with the GovCloud client ID above.
